text:
Communication
Technical Procedure
Introduction
The CR-310 is a 
communication recorder with audio tape recorder which records data onto VHS 
video cassette tapes, it can record continuously for 24 hours on 10 channels 
with automatic control of recording levels
The
first draft is initiated & tested by eng. Abdel-Aleem Ahmed, accepted by eng. 
Sleem Ahmed Ali general director, 
approved by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic 
Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control general director, and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Work to be Carried Out
Turn off the power through recorder switch .
Open the front cover of the device through two screw polts .
Dismantle the mechanical drive and replace the rolls by 
 another new .
Clean the mechanical drive by using dry cleaning spray .
Plug out the cards respectively and clean the contact points .
Clean the recorder from inside by using air blower .
Clean the mother board contact points .
Plug in the cards respectively as before
